ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-3,
Community Shopping Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-J in the
area bound by:

      West Fifth Avenue; South Homan Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West
      Fifth Avenue; and South Trumbull Avenue,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        ____________________________
                                                        Jason C. Ervin
                                                        Alderman, 28th Ward




Common Address:
3401-3425 W. Fifth Avenue
